title: Grateful Dead Live at Oregon Country Fair on 1982-08-28
lineage: Cassette  (Nakamichi DR-1) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.03 -> FLAC/16

ai_review.summary: Decent unknown‑source recording of an energetic 1982 outdoor show with debut performances of “Day Job” and “West LA Fadeaway,” strong Jerry vocals and sizzling Brent keyboards.
ai_review.review: The concert is remembered as a solid, clean performance with good song selection; fans especially highlight the first live renditions of “Day Job” and “West LA Fadeaway” plus a glittering “Black Peter.”  While no one mentions technical flaws, the recording is generally considered listenable, though its exact source (soundboard vs. audience) isn’t identified.

ai_rating.rationale: Three of four reviewers gave high marks (4‑5 stars) and praised the music, while one gave a zero rating with no musical commentary; overall show quality is good and recording appears acceptable, leading to a mid‑high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No specific comments on soundboard or audience mix; reviewers note the show sounds clean enough for enjoyment.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Solid set with strong song selection; not consistently 'smokin'' from start to finish but maintains a good flow throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Strong vocals noted, especially after a short break that helped his voice recover.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent's keyboard work described as sizzling.
